title: vpc-observability-terraform-module: helm-based prometheus/grafana + otel + s3-log-forwarder with upgrade probes
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Create a reusable Terraform module to deploy the observability stack into customer VPCs: Prometheus + Grafana (via Helm), an OpenTelemetry collector (helm chart), and a resilient log-forwarding component that ships logs to an S3-compatible target or cross-account Kinesis. The module must include blue/green upgrade primitives, health probes for automated canary checks, IAM resources for cross-account log delivery, and Terraform-driven drift detection hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module can install Prometheus and Grafana via Helm with configurable values and chart versions
OTel collector deploys as DaemonSet (or sidecar option) and receives metrics/traces from private workloads
Log forwarder supports S3 and Kinesis outputs with cross-account role setup templates
Module exposes a 'canary' Helm release path: new release applied to 10% of nodes/instances and evaluated by health probes before full rollout
Automated health checks evaluate: scrape success rate > 99%, Grafana dashboard provisioning verified, log-forwarder delivery latency < 30s and error rate < 0.5%
Module publishes a terraform output 'observability_health' and a 'rollback_trigger' boolean that can be consumed by orchestration pipelines
Drift detection plan exists (terraform plan + governance job) and docs explain remediation steps
decisions: Use Helm provider in Terraform rather than raw K8s manifests to keep chart upgrades predictable and make values overrides explicit
Offer two deployment patterns: 'daemonset' for collector (low-latency tracing) and 'standalone' collector with autoscaling for cost-sensitive customers
Log shipping will default to S3-compatible target with an optional Kinesis path for customers requiring streaming analytics
Blue/green will be implemented by creating a temporary 'canary' release namespace and a traffic-mirroring sidecar where possible; full promotion uses Helm release rename strategy
Health checks will combine Prometheus metrics, otel collector self-health, and application-level log sampling to decide promotion/rollback
rollout_plan: 1) Merge terraform module and chart value templates behind feature flag. 2) Run smoke deploy to staging VPC (automated pipeline). 3) Create canary release targeting 10% of nodes; run 72-hour health window and synthetic queries (scrape + grafana provisioning + sample log ingestion). 4) If error rate < threshold and no critical alerts, promote to full rollout. 5) If failure, automatically trigger terraform apply to restore previous helm release and create a rollback incident. 6) Post-mortem and release notes.
tasks: Draft module interface and variables (namespaces, chart versions, storage classes)
Implement Helm provider resources and templates for Prometheus/Grafana
Build OTEL collector chart wrapper with daemonset/standalone toggles
Implement S3 and Kinesis log-forwarder templates and IAM role examples
Add health-check Lambda or Kubernetes Job that evaluates canary metrics and flips terraform-managed 'rollback_trigger'
Write acceptance tests (k8s conformance checks, end-to-end log ingestion)
Documentation: usage guide, upgrade playbook, runbooks for failed upgrades
Create example terraform root module for demo customer VPC
